errors.description: modem_packet_q is a multi-bit value produced in modem_clk and sampled directly in host_clk without a bundled-data handshake or hold guarantee.
syncword_pulse_q is a one-cycle modem_clk pulse consumed directly in host_clk, so the event can be missed or sampled metastably.
syncword_toggle_q reconverges with a one-sample host_clk history, allowing metastability or double-counting in host_event_o.
link_mode_sync_q receives independently synchronized bits from encoded control vector link_mode_q before decoding in host_clk, so transient illegal modes can be observed.
modem_rst_n is used as data inside host_clk logic, so reset deassertion can asynchronously change destination state.
rf_snapshot_q combines modem_clk payload state with host_clk status state in rf_clk without a cross-domain snapshot protocol.
